query:
MATCH p = ACYCLIC (src:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(:player)
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Uses documented ACYCLIC path mode, outgoing quantified edges and nodes/transform signatures. No DISTINCT or list sorting, so parallel-edge paths retain duplicate node-id lists. Statically checked against current skill references; no database execution.
